summary.en: The Detective Boys are back on the case when a young boy finds himself the unknowing target of a killer. Conan and his friends must use all their deductive powers to protect the tiny tot and bring a murderer to justice before he strikes again. Location: Abandoned building Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Attempted murder and building demolition Location: Abandoned building Crime: Left to demolished The culprit had to demolish the building to kill them, but he escaped through the underground drainage conduit.
